_readme: To add machine #21: copy one object inside 'items' below, keep every key, and re-run scripts/build_site.py. The homepage flip-card slider picks it up automatically. All quantities below come from an internal production planning document and are described as approximate / working estimates, not final production figures.

items.name: Stitching Machine
items.description: The core of our stitching lines, run across multiple simultaneous production styles.
items.details: Approximately 125 stitching machines currently in operation, organised to handle around 10–12 styles at a time (working estimate of ~4–5 units per line).

items.name: Thread Cutting Machine
items.description: Trims excess thread from finished stitched panels ahead of pressing.
items.details: Approximately 10 thread-cutting machines support the stitching department.

items.name: Pressing Machine (Stitching)
items.description: In-line pressing to set seams and finish stitched garments.
items.details: Approximately 10 pressing machines operate within the stitching department.

items.name: Neck / Heat Label Machine
items.description: Applies heat-sealed neck and care labels to finished garments.
items.details: Approximately 11 machines dedicated to neck labelling; labels are sorted and ranked by size before application.

items.name: Fabric Spreading Machine (Spider)
items.description: Spreads fabric layers evenly ahead of cutting for accuracy and minimal waste.
items.details: Approximately 3 spider-type spreading and cutting machines in the cutting department.

items.name: Cutting Table Setup
items.description: Dedicated cutting tables supporting manual and machine-assisted fabric cutting.
items.details: Approximately 4–8 cutting tables in current use, alongside a dedicated cutter machine.

items.name: Automatic Printing Machine
items.description: High-volume automated printing across our core garment categories.
items.details: Approximately 11 automatic printing machines, supporting prints of up to 7–8 colours.

items.name: Manual Printing Machine
items.description: Used for smaller runs, sampling and specialised print placements.
items.details: 1 manual printing machine currently in operation.

items.name: Curing Machine
items.description: Cures and sets printed designs to ensure wash durability.
items.details: 1 curing machine dedicated to the printing department.

items.name: Fusing Machine
items.description: Fuses interlinings and reinforcement layers into garment panels.
items.details: Approximately 4 fusing machines in current use.

items.name: DTP Machine
items.description: Digital transfer printing for detailed, multi-colour designs.
items.details: Part of the printing department's equipment, supporting prints of up to 7–8 colours.

items.name: Plotter
items.description: Outputs printed patterns and markers used across cutting and printing.
items.details: Used alongside our CAD systems to prepare production-ready pattern outputs.

items.name: Embroidery Machine
items.description: Multi-head embroidery for logos, motifs and detailed garment work.
items.details: Approximately 3–4 embroidery machines, managed through Wings embroidery software and typically running around 10 jobs at a time.

items.name: Packing Machine
items.description: Final packing stage before goods move to dispatch.
items.details: 1 packing machine, supporting a current working estimate of approximately 6,000–7,000 pieces dispatched per month.

items.name: Dispatch Lifts
items.description: Moves packed goods between floors ahead of dispatch.
items.details: 2 lifts currently support the dispatch area.

items.name: Audaces CAD System
items.description: Computer-aided pattern making and marker planning ahead of cutting.
items.details: Audaces CAD software is used across the cutting department's pattern preparation.

items.name: Great Eastern ERP System
items.description: Production and dispatch planning software used across the dispatch team.
items.details: Great Eastern software supports dispatch planning, alongside our MRP tagging system.

items.name: MRP Tag System
items.description: Tags and tracks finished goods through packing and dispatch.
items.details: Used in combination with Great Eastern software to manage dispatch records.

items.name: Design Work Table Setup
items.description: Pattern drafting and sample-making workstations for the design team.
items.details: 2 dedicated work tables support our in-house design and tailoring team of approximately 10 designers and 3 tailors.

items.name: Graphic Design Workstation
items.description: Digital design workstations for artwork, prints and embroidery files.
items.details: Approximately 5 PCs dedicated to graphic design, alongside 10 tables and 1 conference room supporting the design process (current working estimate of 150+ new designs per month).

items.name: Fabric Management System
items.description: Software used to track fabric colour stock and availability.
items.details: 2 software systems support our dedicated fabric team, currently managing a working library of 50+ colours.
